liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Greatest Story Ever Told** (3 reviews): Jerry's solo on this song is described as very hot; Set one took off immediately with high energy and upbeat songs [16][23][24]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Source notes the track fades out early, before its climax [19]
- **Supplication** (1 review): Reviewer finds this performance exceptionally inventive and well-woven [19]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Reviewer highlights the fun speed-up in this track [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-02-17.sbd.scotton-miller.88123.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 26 songs; 180 min; rated 4.58/5 by 12 [1]
- **gd1979-02-17.145263.sbd.troy.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: soundboard; 27 songs; 185 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd79-02-17.sbd.kempka.313.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 165 min; rated 3.4/5 by 45 [8]. Said about its sound: Recording is not a reel master; multiple cassette generations are present; Band plays very fast with high energy, though quality needs upgrading [20]
- **gd1979-02-17.166987.sbd.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: soundboard; 25 songs; 182 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [11]

## Around the show

- Marked on calendars as Keith and Donna's final performance together [15]
- Jane Fonda showed a film before the band began playing [17]
- Heavy rain outside caused water inside and steam-like fog as temps rose [18]
- Hanoi Jane and Tom Hayden attended to promote their environmental cause [18]
- Jane Fonda and Tom Hayden hosted, showing 'Fun with Dick and Jane' [23]
- Keith and Donna's final show saw the band going off uniquely [25]
- Keith and Donna's final show, a Rock For Life benefit [2]
- Keith and Donna's last show, a Rock for Life benefit [7]
- Reviewer calls the first set one of the best they have heard [15]
- First set is strong, but the second set sounds disjointed and tired [22]
- First set is considered better than the second set overall [24]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-02-17.sbd.scotton-miller.88123.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> ? -> Dat -> CD [1]. Also: Discs labeled Master Reel, but uploader strongly doubts this claim; Set 2 disc change is seamless in this recording [1]
- **gd1979-02-17.145263.sbd.troy.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Sandy Troy; transferred by Matt Smith, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Soundboard Cassettes > 1st generation reels > Sandy Troy's 2nd generation reels @ 3.75 ips [2]. Also: Two sets of soundboard masters were used to complete this recording [2]
- **gd79-02-17.sbd.kempka.313.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Jeff Kempka; source: Soundboard [8]
- **gd1979-02-17.166987.sbd.smith.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Matt Smith;Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard Reels @ 3.75 ips (Maxell) of unknown provenance (eBay tape liberation) [11]. Also: Soundboard source patches gaps in Looks Like Rain, Terrapin, and Jam [11]
